# Bob's Repair

> Bob's Repair is a Las Vegas-based HVAC, solar, and home services company offering expert installation, repair, and maintenance with same-day emergency service.

Founded by the Prandecki brothers, Bob's Repair serves the Las Vegas Valley with certified technicians and comprehensive home comfort solutions including AC systems, heating, solar installation, water heaters, electrical services, and air duct cleaning.
